notes: The session's shared web-search allowance ran out after this part's first six searches (Pederson, Reed Johnson, DesLauriers, Larson, Bailey, Hegvik). Everything else was read directly with the kit's own User-Agent: each county's own site, the North Dakota Court System, the Democratic-NPL's own candidate pages, and campaign addresses. No search engine was read in place of the search tool.

County sites not reached or not naming the person: Bowman (sheriff page names nobody), Ransom (refused the connection), Logan (certificate error; not worked around), Sioux (no site found), Mercer, Pierce and McIntosh (pages name no office holder). Billings, Grand Forks, Traill and Mountrail pages list other people in those seats, so Kessel, Duray, Wright and Fiesel appear not to hold them today.
Emmons County's sheriff page lists a Chris Vargas as Chief Deputy Sheriff; that is a job, not an office, so it is not recorded.

The state Republican Party's site (ndgop.org) carries no list of endorsed legislative candidates that could be found, so no Republican endorsement is recorded. News reports say District 3 Republicans endorsed other candidates and DesLauriers won the June primary; that is not a party page, so it is left out.
district13.us, which the party lists as Landis Larson's website, is the District 13 Democratic-NPL's site, not his own campaign's, so no website is recorded for him.
